pending.title: Pending
pending.intro: Find decisions and questions that need your response. Read the context before answering.
pending.identity: The recipient helps you find a request; anyone with panel access can answer it. The name entered does not verify identity.
pending.error: Could not load requests. Try again.
pending.savedResumeFailed: Could not confirm whether the response was saved. Do not submit a different answer; check the status in Dagu or retry exactly the same response.
pending.sendError: Could not submit the response. The request may have changed; refresh and try again.
pending.unsupported: This form contains unsupported fields. Open the run in Dagu to answer it.
pending.historyIntro: Open a request to see its delivery step status. Use Refresh to check for changes.
pending.historyEmpty: There is no recent activity for this filter.
pending.historyError: Could not load recent activity. Refresh to try again.
pending.historyLimited: Showing up to 20 recent requests. Check the history for more.
pending.answerHistoryNote: No response is available in this request’s history.
pending.question: Question and context
pending.responderRequired: Enter your name before cancelling the request.
pending.emptyHelp: Questions for you or your team will appear here.
pending.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? It will be recorded as cancelled.

delivery.pending: The next step is still pending. You can check its status in the history.
delivery.processed: The delivery step finished. This does not confirm that the agent completed its work.
delivery.failed: The response is saved, but the delivery step failed. Check the history; do not submit a different answer to this request.
delivery.invalid: The saved response or choices are invalid. Ask the agent to create a new request; this response was not delivered.
delivery.unknown: Could not confirm the delivery status. Check the history.
delivery.awaitingAnswer: A response has not been recorded yet.

pending.outputsError: Could not load the saved response. Close and reopen this request to try again.
pending.recordPending: Saving the response. This view will update automatically.
pending.recordDelayed: The response is still being recorded. Close and reopen the request to check again.
pending.resumePending: The response is saved, but the request could not be resumed.
pending.resumeQueued: Resuming was requested. Check the status for the result.
pending.resumeError: Could not request resuming. Try again.
